keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words or phrases to find (case-insensitive). A title matches at a word start ("engineer" matches "Engineering Manager"); description matching needs every word of the keyword, and covers the first ~1,500 characters. Leave empty for all jobs.

keywordMatch.title: Keyword match
keywordMatch.description: "any": a job needs at least one keyword. "all": a job needs every keyword.

keywordScope.title: Keyword scope
keywordScope.description: title: keywords must appear in the job title. title_and_description: in the title, or (every word of the keyword) in the department, team or the first ~1,500 characters of the description.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords (title)
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these, e.g. "senior", "intern".

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, state, country or region as written in the posting (e.g. "Berlin", "California", "Remote (EU)"), or a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. "US", "DE"). A job matches if any location matches.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: remote_only: remote jobs only. onsite_only: excludes jobs marked remote (on-site, hybrid and unspecified remain).

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs first published in the last N days. Empty = any age.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Only these companies: company names ("Datadog") or board tokens ("datadog", "greenhouse:datadog").

ats.title: Job-board platforms
ats.description: Only jobs from these applicant tracking systems. Empty = all.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Substring match on department or team, e.g. "engineering", "sales".

employmentTypes.title: Employment types
employmentTypes.description: Normalized employment type. Jobs whose ATS does not state one (most Greenhouse boards) are excluded when this is set.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (and charge for). Newest first.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Fetch the full plain-text description (HTML stripped, contact details redacted, max 20,000 characters) live from the company's ATS for every delivered job. Adds a few seconds per company. A 300-character snippet is always included.

sinceLastRun.title: Only new jobs since last run
sinceLastRun.description: Incremental feed: remembers delivered jobs per filter combination (in a named key-value store in your account) and returns only jobs posted since, so a scheduled run never re-delivers or re-charges a job.

companyUrls.title: Live mode: job-board URLs
companyUrls.description: Optional. Fetch these boards live instead of searching the index, e.g. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/gitlab, https://jobs.lever.co/acme, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme, https://apply.workable.com/acme, https://acme.recruitee.com or "greenhouse:gitlab". All filters above still apply.
companyUrls.sectionCaption: Live mode (companies not yet in the index)
